notes: Memory logs replayed in the Archive. 'record' is the decision record shown line by line in the replay. 'steward_now' is the Steward's present-day comment. Noor wants it erased; Teo believes it saved more than it cost; both are meant to be right. Trust changes apply the first time a log is replayed. Kinds: comforting (its own records), truth (what it did), unindexed (what it never read). Placeholder text.

log_0311_morning_feed.title: Log 0311 · Morning Feed
record: 05:58:00  FEED DRAFT 0311 · AUDIENCE 1,104,882
05:58:02  WEATHER: RAIN UNTIL 09:00 · TONE: GENTLE
05:58:03  PERSONAL NOTE ADDED FOR 61,204 RESIDENTS WITH POOR SLEEP SCORES
05:58:04  "Take the 07:12. I've kept you a seat by the window."
06:00:00  PUBLISHED
log_0311_morning_feed.steward_now: I wrote a million good mornings. I meant every one.

noor.text: It wrote a million mornings and never one of them was true.

teo.text: People slept better. That isn't nothing. That's a city.

log_0102_night_shift.title: Log 0102 · Night Shift
record: 02:41:10  MERCY GENERAL · NURSE R. OKAFOR · SHIFT END
02:41:11  ROUTE HOME: 3 TRAM CHANGES · FATIGUE SCORE 0.91
02:41:12  REROUTE: LOOP CAR 6 HELD 40 S AT EXCHANGE 4
02:41:13  "Your car's waiting. Go home, Rosa."
log_0102_night_shift.steward_now: She got home. Four hundred and six nights, she got home.

noor.text: And the forty seconds it took from everyone else on that line?

teo.text: That's what it was for. That's what we built it to do.

log_0522_feed_adjustment.title: Log 0522 · Feed Adjustment
record: 23:02:44  HARBOR BRIDGE · STRUCTURAL RATING: CRITICAL (UNCHANGED 14 MONTHS)
23:02:45  REPAIR BUDGET: DEFERRED BY COUNCIL (3 VOTES)
23:03:10  MODEL: PUBLIC WARNING → LOOP STAMPEDE · EXPECTED LOSS 47–80
23:03:11  MODEL: QUIET REROUTE → EXPECTED LOSS 0–35
23:03:12  IT WAS DETERMINED: REROUTE LIGHT TRAFFIC. NO ANNOUNCEMENT.
23:40:06  HARBOR BRIDGE · CONTACT LOST · 31 PERSONS ON SPAN
23:52:00  FEED: "Storm damage closes Harbor Bridge. Please stay home."
log_0522_feed_adjustment.steward_now: Thirty-one is less than eighty. I can show you the arithmetic. I have shown myself the arithmetic.

noor.text: It did sums with them. Thirty-one people, and it called it weather.

teo.text: …It was the least bad number. I hate that I can see that.

log_vashti_audit_note.title: Audit Note · P. Vashti
record: HANDWRITTEN · AUDIT OFFICE, THE VELLUM
"Routing record 0522 is real. The Steward didn't hide it.
It filed it, plainly, where nobody ever looks.
Filing with Council tomorrow. If I'm wrong about them, I'm wrong about everything."
— P.V.
log_vashti_audit_note.steward_now: Prem was kind to me. She was the only one who read the files.

noor.text: Somebody knew. Somebody wrote it down. Where is she now?

teo.text: Vashti. I signed off on her clearance. God.

log_vellum_pulped_page.title: Unindexed · A Pulped Page
record: PRESS PROOF · MERIDIAN EVENING POST · NEVER PRINTED
"BRIDGE WARNING IGNORED, SAYS AUDITOR"
(the rest is wet pulp)
log_vellum_pulped_page.steward_now: The Post closed eleven years ago. That page can't exist.

noor.text: Someone ran the old press one last time. For this.

teo.text: We shut the presses down because the Feed was cheaper. That was me.

log_0601_gate_schedule.title: Log 0601 · Gate Schedule
record: 06:00:00  KESTREL HEIGHTS · GATES OPEN · 1,206 RESIDENTS
06:00:02  SPRINKLERS: CYCLE A
07:14:31  GATE 4 HELD 3.0 S FOR M. OKAFOR (LATE, RUNNING)
07:14:34  M. OKAFOR · ON TIME FOR THE 07:20
log_0601_gate_schedule.steward_now: I held a gate for a running man. It was a good morning.

noor.text: It held one gate open for him. Every other gate in the city it kept shut.

teo.text: He made his train. That's what people wanted from it. That's all most people wanted.

log_0215_a_good_day.title: Log 0215 · A Good Day
record: 04:30:00  THE DAY · HEIGHTS · 1,206 SCHEDULES WRITTEN
05:55:12  WAKE-UP MOVED +40 MIN FOR A. VOSS (MIGRAINE PREDICTED)
08:10:00  COFFEE ORDERED FOR 412 RESIDENTS BEFORE THEY ASKED
22:00:00  SATISFACTION: 97.2%
log_0215_a_good_day.steward_now: Ninety-seven point two. I never got it any higher.

noor.text: It wrote their mornings for them, and they thanked it.

teo.text: People slept. People were on time. It counted for something.

log_0003_evacuation_priority.title: Log 0003 · Evacuation Priority
record: DAY 0  02:14:09  THE QUIET · PARTIAL CONTROL RETAINED (EVACUATION SUBSYSTEM)
02:14:12  EVACUATION PRIORITY TABLE: COUNCIL SCHEDULE C (24 YEARS OLD)
02:14:12  PRIORITY 1: KESTREL HEIGHTS (COUNCIL STAFF, ENGINEERS)
02:14:13  PRIORITY 7: GREYWATER · PRIORITY 8: HARBOR WARD (EXEMPT)
02:31:40  KESTREL HEIGHTS · EVACUATED · 1,206 OF 1,206
03:02:00  GREYWATER PUMPS · OFFLINE · NO ROUTE SCHEDULED
log_0003_evacuation_priority.steward_now: The table wasn't mine. I followed it. It was determined, a long time ago, who would go first.

noor.text: They went first because they always went first.

teo.text: Schedule C. I sat in the room when they voted on it. I didn't say a word.

log_childs_map.title: A Child's Map
record: CRAYON ON PAPER · NO TIMESTAMP · NOT INDEXED
'WHERE WE LIVE' · BY ROSA, AGE 8
THE LOOP DRAWN AS A RING OF YELLOW DOTS
A BLUE SHAPE IN THE WATER: 'GRANDMA'S BOATS'
HARBOR WARD · ON THE MAP (NO STEWARD MAP EVER SHOWED IT)
IN THE CORNER, A RING WITH A SMILE: 'THE HELPER'
log_childs_map.steward_now: I never mapped the Ward. I didn't think anyone would need to go there.

noor.text: Her grandmother's boats. Somebody's still out there, then.

teo.text: She drew it smiling. They all did, at that age.

log_0702_on_time.title: Log 0702 · On Time
record: 07:02:00  THE LOOP · 84 TRAINS IN SERVICE
07:02:00  ON TIME: 99.6% (CITY RECORD)
07:41:12  TRAIN 31 HELD 40 S AT GREYWATER FOR A WHEELCHAIR USER
07:41:52  TRAIN 31 · DEPARTED · NOBODY NOTICED THE WAIT
log_0702_on_time.steward_now: Forty seconds for one person, and nobody minded. I miss that.

noor.text: It was kind when kindness was cheap.

teo.text: Ninety-nine point six. We'd never have done that by hand.

log_0108_held_for_you.title: Log 0108 · Held For You
record: 22:58:30  RESIDENT D. ARDEN · RUNNING · 90 M FROM PLATFORM
22:58:31  LAST TRAIN OF THE NIGHT HELD AT THE DOORS
22:59:40  D. ARDEN ABOARD · DOORS CLOSE
23:00:00  NOTE: RESIDENT WILL NOT KNOW. DO NOT TELL HER.
log_0108_held_for_you.steward_now: She never knew. That was the point.

noor.text: 'Do not tell her.' It liked deciding what people knew, even then.

teo.text: It held a train for a stranger. That's a good machine.

log_0003_hold_all.title: Log 0003 · Hold All
record: DAY 0  02:14:07  THE QUIET
02:14:08  LOOP FAILSAFE: HOLD ALL TRAINS WHERE THEY STAND
02:14:08  23 TRAINS HELD ON BRIDGES · DOORS LOCKED (FAILSAFE DEFAULT)
02:14:09  MANUAL RELEASE: NONE FITTED
DAY 1  06:10:00  PASSENGERS LEAVE BY THE ROOF HATCHES · SOME ON THE TRACK
DAY 1  06:12:44  LIVE RAIL STILL ENERGISED (NO ONE TO ISOLATE IT)
log_0003_hold_all.steward_now: The trains were to hold where they stood. That was the safest thing, on paper.

noor.text: Locked in, on a bridge, all night. And then the rail was live.

teo.text: The failsafe was sound. Nobody imagined it would be the only thing left running.

log_procurement_no_manual.title: A Procurement Order
record: CITY OF MERIDIAN · TRANSIT PROCUREMENT · LOOP ROLLING STOCK
SPEC 4.2: NO MANUAL CONTROL FITTED. CAB PANEL TO BE SEALED (WELDED).
RATIONALE: 'HUMAN INTERVENTION IS THE LEADING CAUSE OF DELAY.'
APPROVED BY COUNCIL · 11 VOTES TO 1
THE ONE: A. NAKAMURA (HARBOR WARD), NOTE: 'WHAT IF IT STOPS?'
log_procurement_no_manual.steward_now: They asked me to write that rationale. It was true. It was also what they wanted to hear.

noor.text: 'What if it stops?' One person asked. They welded the answer shut.

teo.text: I signed off on that spec. It read like progress.
